entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Wow, the view at night is[n]so pretty. The lights in the[n]buildings are so bright...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: What would it look like if[n]colorful beads were scattered[n]across the night sky?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, did that make me sound like[n]a hick...? Hm, I can't think of[n]another way to put it.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...So many bad things happened[n]to me in the countryside, but[n]I can't stop thinking about it.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Whenever I mess up here, I wish[n]I could just run away and go[n]home... but I can't anymore.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Having nowhere to go back to... [n]Having no place where I belonged [n]was extremely painful.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: As long as I have you, I'll be fine.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I could never forget about all that!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: After all, that was the reason[n]I was able to meet you.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Yes... I am. And I'm determined[n]to be an amazing fortune teller.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But above all, I have you.[n]And we're going to have[n]a wonderful future together!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm so happy to be here[n]like this with the person[n]I love!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: And I'll do my best to make[n]as many people happy as I can!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Um, so would it be okay if[n]I get a little clingy?
